styles.name: 8 Direction Rotation
styles.description: Create 8 direction rotations of anything.

styles.name: Any Animation
styles.description: Describe an animation and bring pixel art to life. Accepts 64x64 input images, or just use a prompt.
styles.example_prompt: An orange cat playing with a blue ball of yarn

styles.name: Big Animation
styles.description: Describe an animation and bring pixel art to life. Accepts 128x128 input images, or just use a prompt.
styles.example_prompt: An orange cat playing with a blue ball of yarn

styles.name: Custom Action
styles.description: Add a starting frame then describe any animation to bring the image to life. Made in partnership with PixelEngine.
styles.example_prompt: a knight walking, his steps are heavy because of his armor

styles.name: Default
styles.description: Clean modern pixel art style model that allows multiple reference images and extremely detailed prompting.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Style test
styles.description: Clean modern pixel art style model that allows multiple reference images and extremely detailed prompting.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Tileset
styles.description: Create full tilesets from a simple prompt describing the textures or environment, using a simple set of "wang" style combinations
styles.example_prompt: Example: Simple path with grass, and dirt with rocks in it

styles.name: Large Walk & Idle
styles.description: 64x64 pixel consistent 4 direction walking and idle animations of humanoid characters

styles.name: Painterly
styles.description: Almost brush-like style with minimal outlines or anti-aliasing. Clean vibrant color palettes and beautiful details
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Tileset Advanced
styles.description: Full tilesets from two prompts and/or textures, using a simple set of "wang" style combinations
styles.example_prompt: Example: Grey stones with gravel and dirt

styles.name: Walking
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the character walking. Best results when uploading a neutral pose.
styles.example_prompt: Slow, heavy steps

styles.name: Idle
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the character idle sequence. Best results when uploading a neutral pose.
styles.example_prompt: Slight weight shifting

styles.name: Simple
styles.description: Simple pixel art with minimal shading or texturing, but strong outlines and shapes.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Single Tile
styles.description: Detailed single tile texture for creating full tilesets or surfaces
styles.example_prompt: Example: Volcanic rock with cracks and seams exposing glowing lava

styles.name: Walking & Idle
styles.description: Consistent 4 direction walking and idle animations of humanoid characters
styles.example_prompt: Example: A man with a beard and sunglasses wearing a flower print hawaiian shirt

styles.name: Fantasy
styles.description: Bright colors, soft transitions, detailed textures, light dithering, and outlines.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Four Angle Walking
styles.description: Consistent 4 direction, 4 frame long walking animations of humanoid characters
styles.example_prompt: Example: A man with a beard and sunglasses wearing a flower print hawaiian shirt

styles.name: Jump
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the character jump sequence. Best results when uploading a neutral pose.
styles.example_prompt: Wing flapping at apex

styles.name: Tile Variation
styles.description: Texture variations of the provided tile image
styles.example_prompt: Example: Add moss and cracks

styles.name: Battle Sprites
styles.description: 4 direction sprites with 3-frame idle, 6-frame walk, 2-frame jump, and 3-frame attack. Everything you need for a top-down rpg.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A knight with gold armor and red wings holding a steel sword

styles.name: Crouch
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the character crouching sequence. Best results when uploading a neutral pose.
styles.example_prompt: Stealthy pose

styles.name: Horror
styles.description: Dark, gritty style with chaotic details and harsh shapes and shading.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Small Sprites
styles.description: 4 direction 32x32 sprites with walking, arm raising/attacking, looking around, surprised, and laying down animations.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A yellow duck wearing a brown trenchcoat

styles.name: Tile Object
styles.description: Small assets for placing on sections of tiles
styles.example_prompt: Example: A tall wobbly red mushroom with white spots

styles.name: Attack
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the character attack sequence. Best results when uploading a neutral pose.
styles.example_prompt: Over head sword swing, big impact

styles.name: Scene Object
styles.description: Large assets for placing on tileset maps
styles.example_prompt: Example: A log cabin with a roof covered in moss on a neutral grey background

styles.name: Sci-fi
styles.description: High contrast with glowing details, clean outlines, and beautiful lighting.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven standing on a branch with appalachian forests and mountains in the background

styles.name: Visual Effects
styles.description: Eye-catching animations for fire, explosions, lightning, or other simple effects
styles.example_prompt: Example: A magic blue portal glowing with intricate swirling patterns and emitting sparks

styles.name: Destroy
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the content being destroyed. Add a description to specify how the content is broken.
styles.example_prompt: Shattered into many small pieces

styles.name: Isometric
styles.description: Pixel art rotated at a 45 degree angle. Clean lines and shapes.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A military tank in the desert, covered with battle damage

styles.name: Subtle Motion
styles.description: Upload a starting frame and generate to animate the content with subtle motion, like rain falling, leaves rustling, etc. Ideal to bring landscapes to life. Made in partnership with PixelEngine.
styles.example_prompt: Peaceful gentle breeze

styles.name: Top Down
styles.description: Pixel art viewed from a 2/3 downwards angle, with simple shapes and shading.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A martian colony with astronauts wandering around and bubbles for air and growing plants

styles.name: Platformer
styles.description: Side-scroller style platformer perspective, with modern styling and outlines.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A forest with ancient ruins and stone platforms connected by vines

styles.name: Dungeon Map
styles.description: Dungeon-crawler style game levels with connected rooms filled with objects and enemies.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A sewer with pipes connecting rooms full of trash and slime enemies

styles.name: Spritesheet
styles.description: Collections of assets on a simple background with the same style.
styles.example_prompt: Example: Medieval weapons with magic runes, and rings with elemental seals

styles.name: Hexagonal Tiles
styles.description: Small collection of hexagonal tiles for game maps.
styles.example_prompt: Example: Mars colony, with red sand, stone, and space civilization bubbles

styles.name: FPS Weapon
styles.description: First person perspective weapons, items, and objects.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A man holding a modern shotgun, wearing military gear.

styles.name: Typography
styles.description: Generate logos, buttons, or any other element using text as the central focus.
styles.example_prompt: Example: "Retro Diffusion" written in big letters made of copper wires on a circuit board

styles.name: UI Panel
styles.description: Consistent arrangements of UI elements, split into buttons, sliders, panels, and knobs.
styles.example_prompt: Example: Stone buttons with a blue glowing exp bar.

styles.name: Inventory Items
styles.description: Creates a spritesheet of grid aligned inventory items (like for Diablo or Path of Exile)
styles.example_prompt: Example: weapons and armor for a blood wizard

styles.name: Dinoki
styles.description: Dinoki
styles.example_prompt: Example: A woman wearing golden armor with red demon wings

styles.name: General Animation EXPERIMENTAL
styles.description: Work-in-progress general animation model. Create animated sequences for anything you describe.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A cat playing with a ball of red yarn

styles.name: Pixelate
styles.description: Convert input images into pixel art.
styles.example_prompt: Example: A raven with a glowing eye on a lime green background

styles.name: Edit
styles.description: Upload an image and describe the changes you want. You can use up to 9 references.
styles.example_prompt: Example: Make the reference into pixel art, with black outlines and light dithering
